vibe: Accessible, highly functional, trustworthy, earthy-modern. Designed to bridge the gap between robust enterprise dashboards and accessible rural-user mobile PWAs.

colors.white_label_instructions: Tenant specific theming MUST be implemented via CSS variables dynamically injected into the root container of the Tenant App, e.g., style={{ '--primary': tenant.theme.primary, '--secondary': tenant.theme.secondary }}. Use Tailwind's config to map these vars.

typography.notes: Work Sans is chosen for maximum legibility of numbers and data, crucial for rural users and data-heavy manager dashboards. Outfit provides a modern, approachable face to the brand headers.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Sidebars col-span-1, Main content col-span-3.
spacing_and_layout.pwa_mobile_grid: Grid mode 'TETRIS'. 9-card menu uses grid-cols-2 gap-4. High priority actions (Check-in/out) take col-span-2 row-span-1.
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items) to accommodate rural users on mobile devices.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-hover rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-secondary-hover rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-text-secondary hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-text-primary rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-surface rounded-xl border border-border shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col
cards.pwa_action_card: bg-surface rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-md p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center active:scale-95 transition-transform

inputs.text: w-full h-12 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all
inputs.select: w-full h-12 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-text-primary mb-2

maps.style: Use OpenStreetMap tiles. Round corners of map container (rounded-xl) with overflow-hidden and border border-border.

navigation.dashboard_sidebar: w-64 bg-surface border-r border-border h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col
navigation.pwa_bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-surface border-t border-border h-16 flex justify-around items-center pb-safe-area shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] z-50

surfaces.Super_Admin_Dashboard: High density, Desktop-first. Focus on table grids for tenants, multi-axis charts for global analytics. 'Control Room' mode.
surfaces.Tenant_Admin_Dashboard: Desktop-first. Configuration heavy. Includes a visual 'Live Preview' when changing branding colors/labels.
surfaces.Manager_Dashboard: Tablet/Desktop friendly. Focus on Leaflet GPS maps, attendance heatmaps, and performance leaderboards.
surfaces.Employee_Mobile_PWA: Mobile-first, Low-end Android friendly. 'Bento' style 9-card layout. Huge tap targets. Minimal text, reliant on Lucide icons (e.g., MapPin, Camera, FileText).
surfaces.Customer_Dealer_PWA: Mobile-first e-commerce vibe. Branded exactly to tenant specifications. Large product images, bottom fixed 'Cart/Checkout' bar.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for larger icons, 2 for smaller icons. Do not use emojis.

image_urls.description: Man standing on grass field at sunset. Use with bg-black/40 overlay.
Worker carrying a box in an organized warehouse. Good alternative for FMCG tenants.
Clean simple placeholder for Tenant branding if no logo uploaded.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure primary color provides 4.5:1 contrast against white for buttons. Add text-shadow on hero image text.
accessibility_and_testing.i18n: Use a clear Earth globe icon (lucide-react <Globe />) for language switcher. Keys should update instantly across UI.
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. e.g., data-testid='employee-checkin-btn'.

motion.pwa_interactions: active:scale-[0.98] on PWA action cards for tactile feedback.
motion.modals: Slide up from bottom for PWA (Sheet style), center fade-in for Dashboards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, react-leaflet, leaflet for map functionalities.
Set up Tailwind CSS variables mapping in tailwind.config.js for dynamic tenant branding (primary and secondary colors).
Build the Employee PWA Dashboard using the 'Tetris' bento grid rules. Check-In/Check-Out must be a dominant full-width card at the top.
Integrate i18n placeholders effectively, keeping text concise for rural low-end Androids.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Inputs, Selects) use h-12 sizes for mobile PWA views to satisfy the 'large tap target' requirement.
Apply data-testid to every button, form input, and key metric card.
